description: This file implements a server for handling camera connections over a virtual socket (vsock) in an Android hardware camera provider context. It manages connection setup, configuration reading from JSON, and callback invocation upon client connection.

classes.name: VsockCameraServer
classes.description: A server class managing virtual socket connections for camera devices, including starting/stopping the server, handling client connections, and reading configuration settings.

methods.name: containsValidSettings
methods.description: Checks if the provided camera settings have valid dimensions and frame rate.

methods.name: readSettingsFromJson
methods.description: Reads camera settings from a JSON object and validates them.

methods.name: VsockCameraServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server and connection object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server on a specified port and CID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and shuts down connections.

methods.name: setConnectedCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked when a client connects with valid settings.

methods.name: serverLoop
methods.description: Main loop accepting connections and processing client settings.
